svg.text: ↑ prefill: 3 pages at once, side by side
decode: a new page at token 96, wherever a unit is free ↑
· A's state slot is 74 units: 5 here, the rest elsewhere
A's row in the step table
That list of numbers is all the GPU needs to find A's memory:
unit s starts at byte s × 2 MiB. Units never move.
1 page = 32 tokens = 1 unit = 2 MiB (each token: 64 KiB of K and V) · every 32 new tokens, one more unit · the state slot never grows
